item.title: Kmaier Recalls Infant Walkers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fall Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Infant Walkers
item.product: Kmaier Recalls Infant Walkers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fall Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Infant Walkers
item.summary: This recall involves Kmaier-branded infant walkers. The pink, green or white walkers have a tray, a fabric seat and a round base with six-wheels. The walkers can be adjusted to nine different height levels. “Model No.: RV001” is printed on a label located under the walker’s seat.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased the recalled product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
